status: IMPLEMENTED WITH CUSTOMER VOICE URL CONFIGURATION HOLD
scope: phased donor, volunteer, participant, and sponsor Customer Voice surveys
website feedback entry point using Share Your Experience

foundation_canon_alignment.rule: Use Customer Voice for feedback; do not build custom survey infrastructure.
foundation_canon_alignment.privacy_rule: Donor, volunteer, participant/recipient, and sponsor feedback must remain separately classified.

phases.classification: START FIRST - LOWEST RISK / HIGHEST VALUE
phases.primary_use: post-program, post-event, volunteer coordination, Story Hour, Reading Station, Community Table feedback
phases.privacy_boundary: No medical, financial, eligibility, or sensitive assistance details in public feedback text.
phases.validation_gate: Feedback must map to program/volunteer relationship context without creating Lead, Opportunity, or Case by default.

phases.classification: PREPARED - ACTIVATE AFTER CUSTOMER VOICE ADMIN PROOF
phases.primary_use: giving experience, acknowledgment, donor stewardship, donor communication
phases.privacy_boundary: Donation receipt, payment, and ledger issues remain in payment/finance or direct Foundation support channels.
phases.validation_gate: Donor feedback must not expose participant-sensitive data or create Sales Lead/Opportunity by default.

phases.primary_use: recipient, learner, student, family, and program participant feedback
phases.privacy_boundary: Participant feedback is not donor-facing CRM data and requires restricted access review before Dataverse exposure.
phases.validation_gate: Participant feedback must not be visible in donor/sponsor views and must not create Opportunity.

phases.primary_use: sponsor, funder, school, church, community organization, and operating partner feedback
phases.privacy_boundary: Funding and partnership feedback links to sponsor/partner context; sensitive participant detail remains excluded.
phases.validation_gate: Sponsor feedback may inform relationship follow-up but must not become routine donation handling or generic Sales activity.

deployment_model.configuration_method: Azure Static Web App environment variables for published Customer Voice URLs
deployment_model.fallback: Foundation email path remains available until Customer Voice survey URLs are configured.
